paragraphs.text: # PMNote
PMNote helps game project managers find and use public PMNote articles, podcasts and guides when pla
nning releases, managing delivery risks and collaboration, preparing for interviews, and selecting A
leases, managing delivery risks and collaboration, preparing for interviews, and selecting AI tools.
## Try it
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The expected result is a grounded answer with links to the relevant public sources, distinguishing s
ourced claims from advice.
## Requirements
A compatible agent is required. Python 3 and internet access are needed for the optional public-cont
ent reader. No account, API key or paid service is required by the Skill itself. The public resource
s are predominantly in Chinese.
## Data and network
The Skill directs the agent to read public resources at https://pmnote.ai and linked public sources
such as Xiaoyuzhou, Bilibili and Zhihu. For public interview search, the reader obtains the anonymou
s public connection from pmnote.ai and sends the search query to the website’s Supabase endpoint. No
rmal web requests expose the requested URL and network metadata to the destination. It does not requ
ire private credentials or include telemetry. External linked works retain their own rights; the MIT
license covers this Skill package.
## Cursor
Install from the Cursor Marketplace once approved, or add this repository as a plugin source. Ask th
e agent a question about game project management and it can use the bundled `pmnote` skill.
## Kimi Code
The repository includes a native Kimi plugin manifest. Install it from a Kimi Code session with `/pl
ugins install https://github.com/chenhao233/pmnote-agent-plugin`, then start a new session or run `/
reload`. You can invoke the skill as `/skill:pmnote:pmnote`. This direct installation does not mean
the plugin is listed in Kimi's official marketplace.
